data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'wulf', meaning 'wolf'. In Christian context, it can symbolize courage, loyalty, and protection. The name Wolfie carries the meaning “Little wolf” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Wolfie usually hope their child will grow to embody little wolf and live with faith, good character and purpose.
